name: ArtifactsBench
description: ArtifactsBench is a benchmark and evaluation framework for visual code generation by LLMs, focusing on the visual fidelity and interactive integrity of generated artifacts. It programmatically renders artifacts, captures dynamic behavior, and uses a multimodal LLM-as-Judge guided by detailed checklists to provide holistic and reproducible scoring.
reputation: A recent benchmark for visual code generation that is gaining attention for evaluating artifact fidelity and interactive behavior beyond standard code correctness.
notes: First framework to automate human-perceived quality evaluation of visual code generation at scale with high agreement to human experts.
